definition: Nine governed municipality-level fields from NJ DCA's published Fourth Round (2025-2035) affordable-housing calculations. These are observed DCA calculation outputs and factors, not Watchdog legal conclusions.
activation_rule: No marker may be live unless the published Appendix A table reconciles uniquely to all 564 workbook municipalities and the source snapshot passes its statewide control totals. DCA describes the calculations as non-binding guidance.

markers.label: Fourth Round Present Need
markers.description: DCA-published municipal Present Need calculation for the 2025-2035 Fourth Round; non-binding guidance, not a legal determination.
markers.professional_reason: Municipal affordable-housing planning context from DCA's published Fourth Round calculation table.

markers.label: Fourth Round Prospective Need
markers.description: DCA-published municipal Prospective Need calculation before the 1,000/20% cap; non-binding guidance.
markers.professional_reason: Planning context from DCA's published municipal Prospective Need calculation.

markers.label: Fourth Round Prospective Need With Cap
markers.description: DCA-published Prospective Need after the 1,000/20% statutory calculation cap shown in Appendix A; non-binding guidance.
markers.professional_reason: Published DCA capped-calculation context; verify governing legal obligations independently.

markers.label: Qualified Urban Aid Municipality
markers.description: DCA's Qualified Urban Aid Municipality flag used in the Fourth Round calculation methodology.
markers.professional_reason: Explains a key DCA allocation condition in the published Fourth Round table.

markers.label: Equalized Nonresidential Valuation Factor
markers.description: DCA-published Equalized Nonresidential Valuation Factor percentage used in Fourth Round allocation.
markers.professional_reason: Transparent DCA allocation-factor context for municipal planning research.

markers.label: Land Capacity Factor
markers.description: DCA-published Land Capacity Factor percentage used in Fourth Round allocation.
markers.professional_reason: Transparent DCA land-capacity allocation context; not parcel buildability or zoning clearance.

markers.label: Income Capacity Factor
markers.description: DCA-published Income Capacity Factor percentage used in Fourth Round allocation.
markers.professional_reason: Transparent DCA allocation-factor context for municipal housing research.

markers.label: Average Allocation Factor
markers.description: DCA-published Average Allocation Factor percentage used to distribute regional Prospective Need.
markers.professional_reason: Makes the published DCA allocation mechanics inspectable rather than opaque.

markers.label: Fourth Round 1,000/20% Cap
markers.description: DCA-published municipality value for the 1,000/20% Prospective Need calculation cap shown in Appendix A.
markers.professional_reason: Published DCA calculation context; not an independent Watchdog legal interpretation.
